notes: CPW 2026 primary big-game draw, from the per-species Post Draw Recap PDFs: https://cpw.widen.net/content/tl5sj6pnkb/original/postdrawrecapreport_elk-26_05142026_1426.pdf ; https://cpw.widen.net/content/mirgybedih/original/postdrawrecapreport_deer-26_05112026_1505.pdf ; https://cpw.widen.net/content/5facqkeb5y/original/postdrawrecapreport_prong-26_05212026_1006.pdf ; https://cpw.widen.net/content/ukdotas2vv/original/postdrawrecapreport_moose-26_05062026_1222.pdf ; https://cpw.widen.net/content/jj2jizo65j/original/postdrawrecapreport_sheep-26_04222026_1349_wcoversheet.pdf ; https://cpw.widen.net/content/davzdef2ih/original/postdrawrecapreport_goat-26_04222026_1507.pdf. Colorado draws first-choice applicants in preference-point order. drawnOut per residency (adult) is CPW's "Drawn Out At": kind "points" = licenses ran out at that point level (drawnAtLevel of appliedAtLevel drew there); "choice" = every first-choice applicant drew and licenses went to later choices; "leftover" = licenses were left after the draw; "none" = none drawn in that pool; "noApps" = no applicants; "na" = not applicable. hybridTags = licenses CPW issued through the hybrid draw (up to 20% of the quota on hunt codes where it applies), a random draw among applicants below the drawn-out level. Moose, bighorn sheep and mountain goat are drawn by weighted random draw once an applicant holds 3 preference points: drawnOut kind "weighted" (minPoints 3), and their pointLines are by total points (3 preference + weighted points, so 3 preference and 5 weighted = 8). "G" season codes (2025 licenses returned after the fires, guaranteed to the original holders) are left out. Rows with otc true are CPW's unlimited over-the-counter licenses (on sale Aug. 4, no draw), from the brochure's "Over-the-Counter Licenses" panels: one row per valid unit, huntCode = CPW code + "-" + unit, openTo set where the panel says resident only or nonresident; no draw stats. DrawStat: tags = adult licenses drawn by that residency; applicants = adult first-choice applicants; successPct = tags ÷ applicants (computed here; includes licenses drawn through hybrid); minPoints = the drawn-out level (0 when every first-choice applicant drew). pointLines: adult first-choice applicants and successful applicants per preference-point level, checked against CPW's Total Choice 1 lines. Youth and landowner (LPP) pools are not included. Season dates are the 2026 seasons from CPW's Big Game and Sheep & Goat brochures (https://cpw.widen.net/s/5wvx7rggrd/colorado-big-game-hunting-brochure ; https://cpw.widen.net/s/n87kwmkzbt/colorado-sheep-and-goat-brochure): 2466 hunt codes from the hunt tables' own dates, 125 from the brochure's "Season Dates" table for standard archery, muzzleloader and rifle seasons (hunt codes the tables print without a date), 18 without dates (late, private-land and other special seasons the tables don't date, and 3 codes listed under two different dates).
